6 september 1626 folio 108 die sexta septembris p.br joannes sardich baptizavit joannis anthonij de franceschi filium nomine joannem anth.m , natum ex eius matre legitima nomine lucia . compatres autem fuerunt d. anthonius jacobus cursius et d. margarita v.q.d. anthonij jachomin . the father is giovanni antonio de franceschi ; the mother is lucia ; the son takes the father's name entire. this is the household. everything else on this page is the same two parents.

t: 19 April 1628 folio 119 and the godfather is the Captain of Fiume
q: 19 april 1628 folio 119 and the godfather is the captain of fiume die 19 aprilis presbiter joannes sardich baptizavit joannis anthonij de franceschi filiam nomine joanna victoriam , natam ex eius matre legitima nomine lucia . compatres autem fuerunt ill.mus d.nus stefanus, liber baro a rouuere, invictissimi ferdinandi secundi romanorum imperatoris consiliarius, et camerarius ac pincerna, ac civitatis fluminis capitaneus , et d. cassandra uxor d. petri mariae monaldi . the imperial captain of the city stood godfather to this child. that is the highest office in fiume, held by a baron of the emperor's own household, and he is standing at the font for a de franceschi baby. whatever this family was in fiume in 1628, it was not obscure.

t: 9 September 1632 folio 143 and this one was baptised by a bishop
q: 9 september 1632 folio 143 and this one was baptised by a bishop die 9 7bris ill.mus et r.mus d.nus joannes baptista agatich, episcopus segniensis et administrator modrusiensis, s.s.c.m. consiliarius , baptizavit joannis anthonij de franceschi filiam nomine mariam , natam ex eius matre legitima nomine lucia , quae supradicta maria fuit prius catechizata a me, plebano fluminis. compatres autem fuerunt d.nus joannes josephus p[…], v. con. fluminis , et d.na cassandra uxor d. petri mariae monaldi . the bishop of senj came and did it himself. ivan krstitelj agatić giovanni battista agatić was bishop of senj and modruš and an imperial councillor; he is a figure in croatian church history, not a passing curate. and cassandra monaldi is godmother for the second time in four years, which is what a family friend looks like in a register.

t: Omiš, 12 January 1644 and the index has the sex wrong
s: And then the Omiš and Split records were read too all four
q: omiš, 12 january 1644 and the index has the sex wrong l'anno del sig.re 1644 adi 12 genaro … il sig.r don mateo berkoveo d'almissa , sac[erdote] cur[a]to, ha battezato il figlio nato li 9 instante di cap.n zuane de franceschi et sig.ra elena coniugati , al quale fu posto nome nicolò , di questa parochia. compari furono sig.r gierolimo marinovich et sig.ra francesca de franceschi . familysearch indexes this child as nicolaa de franceschi, female . the register says il figlio and al quale fu posto nome nicolò . it is a boy. that is now corrected here. and two things the index does not carry at all. the father is styled cap.n captain . and the godmother is francesca de franceschi , a woman of the family, standing for her own kin: indexes transcribe parents and children, never godparents, so she exists in no index anywhere.

t: …and she is on the same page twice
s: And then the Omiš and Split records were read too all four
q: …and she is on the same page twice …et m[adonn]a zuana giugali, al qual fu posto nome marco di questa parochia. compari furono … cap.n nicolò c[…] et sig.ra francesca de franceschi . the entry directly above, in march 1644, for another family's son. the same woman, the same page, a second godparent turn. a de franceschi standing at the font twice in one opening of the omiš book is exactly the pattern this archive found at svetvinčenat the family that is always being asked. neither appearance is in any index.

t: Omiš, 29 March 1645 born about 1581, the oldest of all
s: And then the Omiš and Split records were read too all four
q: omiš, 29 march 1645 born about 1581, the oldest of all gioannes maria de franceschi obijt die 29 martij, anno etatis suae 64 . one line in a column of deaths, with the year 1645 ruled off at the right. sixty-four in 1645 means born about 1581 the earliest birth year for this surname anywhere in the croatian record, and a full generation before the fiume household above. he is an exact contemporary of pietro antonio detto perini de franceschi (1588 1661) , the man at the head of the omiš family's own twenty-generation chart. this archive is not going to make him perini's brother on a shared surname and a shared decade. it will say that the chart's first generation, which has always rested on the family's own paper, now has a man of the name dying in the parish register beside it. one correction to the index: familysearch dates this death 20 march. the register reads 29 the same hand writes 28 four times in the lines below, and the glyph here carries the descender of a 9.

t: Split, 17 October 1700 a child not expected to live
s: And then the Omiš and Split records were read too all four
q: split, 17 october 1700 a child not expected to live adì 17 ottobre 1700 antonio figlio di egidio de franceschi et di sua consorte maria , al quale fu data l'acqua in casa, in caso di necessità , da me … sac[erdote]; et hoggi supplite le cerimonie … in chiesa di s. gio: battista , con licenza dell'ill.mo … compari furono sig.r … zuane guido, con assistenza del … l'acqua in casa, in caso di necessità is the phrase for an emergency baptism: the child was thought to be dying and was christened where he lay. he lived, and the ceremonies were supplied in church afterwards which is why there is a record at all, and why it is dated to the day of the supplying, not the day of the birth. split had never appeared on this site as a place of the name. it does now, with a household: egidio de franceschi and maria , in the cathedral parish, in 1700. the last lines of the entry the officiant and the second godparent are still not read.

t: Split, 18 May 1716 and he is a canon of Candia
s: And then the Omiš and Split records were read too all four
q: split, 18 may 1716 and he is a canon of candia adì 18 maggio 1716 [il m.to r.do sig.r] can.co don nicolò de franceschi ⟨ can.co di s. vito di candia ⟩ passò da questa alla miglior vita d'anni 90 incirca , munito de ss. sacram.ti dal r.do padre capucino , capelano del ospitale, et fù sepolto nella chiesa del domo in coro nella sepoltura delli sig.ri can.ci . the index called him nicolo de franceschi, burial 18 may 1716, birth 1626 . the register makes him somebody entirely different. he was a canon , and he was buried where canons are buried: in the choir of the cathedral of split , in the chapter's own vault. the cathedral of split is diocletian's mausoleum. he lies inside a roman emperor's tomb. and then the words written in above his name, with a caret : can.co di s. vito di candia canon of st vitus of candia . candia is crete. read it against the arithmetic. ninety in 1716 means born about 1626 , in venetian crete. candia fell to the ottomans in september 1669 after the longest siege in european history; he would have been forty-three. a canon of a cretan church, holding after 1669 a title to a chapter that no longer existed, ends his life in a dalmatian cathedral and is buried with the canons of split. (a note on the reading: the register writes s. vito . the great church of candia was san tito st titus and a split clerk setting down an exiled cretan canonry could easily wr

t: And what that does to the Seget question
s: And then the Omiš and Split records were read too all four
q: and what that does to the seget question this archive carries a page arguing with petar puhmajer, who writes that the de franceschi bought seget from the venier in 1720 , having fled from crete after the cretan war of 1669 , and that the gologorica and seget families are two branches of one. this site contests the second half of that and has always treated the first half the cretan flight as the family's own tradition , recorded but not proved. it is no longer only tradition. here is a de franceschi with a cretan canonry , born about 1626 , dying in dalmatia in 1716 four years before the seget purchase and buried among the canons of split. it does not prove the seget family's descent, and this page does not say it does. it proves something narrower and harder: that men of this surname held office in venetian crete and ended up in dalmatia after the fall of candia. the tradition now has a document standing next to it, and the place to test the rest is the chapter records of split and the archivio del duca di candia in venice where the family's nobility was already proved in 1488.

t: morì ser Piero di Franceschi da Pola
s: And Rovinj is older still 27 May 1619
q: morì ser piero di franceschi da pola adì 27 mago 1619 morì ser piero di fran- ceschi da pola. fu por- tato il suo cad[avere] … off[erta] l 24 three things in three lines. he is ser . not dominus , not plain the venetian courtesy for a man of standing below the patriciate: a merchant, a notary, a citizen. he is da pola . he is not a rovinj man. rovinj's book has him because he died there or was brought there. fu portato il suo cadavere his body was carried . somebody paid to move him. and the offering is 24 lire , where the entries above and below it on the same page run at 2, 6, 12 and 30. this is a book that records what each burial was worth to the church, and his was near the top of the page. seven years before the fiume baptisms, a hundred and forty-two years before the surname is first written at gologorica, and eighty-one years before the family this site follows reaches istria at all.

t: And the second-oldest is a man of Vodnjan
s: And Rovinj is older still 27 May 1619
q: and the second-oldest is a man of vodnjan [27 xbre 1728] e sero. ob[ito] di matt.o de franceschi da dignano l 6 a hundred and nine years later, on the same film, the same book does it again and again the man is a stranger . piero is of pola ; mattio is of dignano , which is vodnjan , twenty kilometres down the coast. this archive's inventory of regions lists vodnjan among the unplaced a town where the surname occurs and nothing joins it to anything. it now has a named man and a date. so does pola, seventy years before the run of pula baptisms this project already reads from 1659. the two oldest de franceschi on the rovinj film are not rovinj people at all. that is worth saying plainly, because a record found in a town's register is normally taken to mean a family of that town, and here it means the opposite: a register of burial offerings catches whoever dies inside the parish , including the traveller and the man carried in from somewhere else.

t: What else the Rovinj film holds
s: And Rovinj is older still 27 May 1619
q: what else the rovinj film holds sixteen records in all, and the shape of them is a household at rovinj across three generations that this archive has never written up: giacomo → vittorio de franceschi , who marries domenica moscarda , daughter of nicolò vittorio and franca → piero anto , baptised 1736 mattio de franceschi and elisabetta → martino , baptised 1722 franco de franceschi and menegha pietro defranceschi and elisabetta dalino , daughter of pietro about 1793 sinforosa de franceschi , daughter of giovanni, and maria , who marries gio batta volsi about 1801 bona defranceschi , daughter of dominicus defranceschi and oliva dorligurro , marrying antonius medelin 1843 burials: petrus, son of michael , born 1790, died 12 june 1864; petrus, son of joseph , born 1765, died 19 january 1829; and julius, son of carlo , born 1853, dead 13 february 1854 at a few months old and one that is ours. on the same film: carlo de franceschi, son of giuseppe da gologorizza and lambertina pesle , marrying maria michelcich, daughter of luca and maria. that is the historian of istria his parents named exactly as the gologorica household books name them with his marriage indexed on a rovinj film. the image has now been opened see below. it is the next thing to read on this reel.

t: 1 March 1852 Carlo De Franceschi is married at his own bedside
s: And Rovinj is older still 27 May 1619
q: 1 march 1852 carlo de franceschi is married at his own bedside 31 addì 1 marzo 1852 rovigno il signor carlo de franceschi q.m giuseppe e della sig.ra lambertina pesle di mattia, da gologorizza di pisino, assessore presso quest'i. r. corte di giustizia , celibe, d'anni 40 , contrasse matrimonio per verba de praesenti colla sig.ra maria michelcich di luca e di maria, celibe, d'anni 26 ; dispensati dalle trine pubblicazioni dall'imp. reg. capitanato distrettuale, urgente necessitate, colla nota del primo marzo c. № 898 ; confessati e communicati, interrogati furono del loro mutuo libero consenso … domenico quarantotto, coop. … al letto dello sposo, per essere gravemente ammalato , nella casa al № … alla presenza delli signori zaccaria maver, procuratore di stato sostituto , e d.r barzan, medico , testimonj. this is the most-cited de franceschi in istria the historian, the deputy, the man whose l'istria this archive spends a whole page arguing with and his own wedding has never been read here until tonight . it is not the wedding anyone would have imagined. he was married lying down. the priest came to the house and performed it al letto dello sposo, per essere gravemente ammalato at the bridegroom's bed, because he was gravely ill. the three readings of the banns were dispensed by the imperial-royal district captaincy that same day , on urgent necessity, by a note numbered 898 : t

t: And then, two years later, a small coffin
s: And Rovinj is older still 27 May 1619
q: and then, two years later, a small coffin on the same rovinj film, logged by this archive before the marriage was ever read: a burial of julius, son of carlo , born 1853, dead 13 february 1854 at a few months old. set beside the entry above, that is very likely the first child of this marriage conceived within a year of a wedding held at a sickbed, and buried before his first birthday. (doc for both records; that they are one family is inf, and rests on the name, the place and the dates)

t: How the wrong answer was reached, and why it failed
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: how the wrong answer was reached, and why it failed the check looked sound. the eighteen-town sweep counted by place-name ; the later sweep resolved records to the parish reel they sit on and produced ninety-three parishes with no vodnjan among them. following the image arks gave dgs 005497893 , and asking the catalogue who made that film returned rimokatolička crkva. župa vižinada . case apparently closed. the catalogue answers by film, and a film can carry more than one parish. reel 005497893 holds two items: vižinada umrli 1754 1831 , the deaths vodnjan rođeni 1815 1866 , the baptisms a search by film number returns the first creator on the reel. the method was right and the question put to it was wrong , and this archive published the result inside twenty minutes without opening a single image. the regions row has been restored.

t: LIBER BAPTIZATORUM IN ECCLESIA S. BLASII DIGNANI
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: liber baptizatorum in ecclesia s. blasii dignani 149 4 decembre [1816] № domus 376 d. stefano de franceschi (de parocho licentia) domenica maria de franceschi , nata li 1.mo decembre catholica femina legitima pater: pietro de franceschi di giuseppe, agricoltore mater: maria malusà q.m matteo di antonio patrini: pietro ved… di raffael × maria lu…anza di franc… conditio: civile the book is headed for the church of st blaise of dignano the great basilica of vodnjan and the first de franceschi entry gives more in one ruled line than most parishes give in a paragraph. a house number: 376. a grandfather: pietro is di giuseppe . a mother with three generations of her own: maria malusà, daughter of the late matteo, son of antonio. and a status: civile . and look who is holding the child. the baptising column reads d. stefano de franceschi, de parocho licentia don stefano de franceschi, by licence of the parish priest. a priest of this surname was serving at vodnjan in 1816 , and he is not baptising only his own kin: on the facing page, on 1 january 1817, he baptises a mescheni child whose mother is michiela de franceschi di giovanni . a priest of the name, and at least five lay households of it, in one small istrian town. this archive has never had that anywhere except gologorica.

t: And the death on that reel is somebody else's
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: and the death on that reel is somebody else's 7 [augusti 1819] № domus 32 mathaeus de franceschi fil[ius] antonii the one death record among these is not vodnjan's at all. its page is headed liber defunctorum castellier kaštelir , a chapelry under vižinada , in the deaths section at the front of the same reel. so the film really does carry de franceschi in two parishes forty kilometres apart , and that is exactly why the wrong answer looked right. mathaeus de franceschi, son of anton, of house 32 at kaštelir, born about 1750, died 7 august 1819 and he belongs on the vižinada side of the reel, not the vodnjan one.

t: Vodnjan and Rovinj, joined at both ends of a century
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: vodnjan and rovinj, joined at both ends of a century two records now tie the two towns together. 1728 in the rovinj book of burial offerings: ob.to di matt.o de franceschi da dignano l 6 . a man of vodnjan, dead in rovinj. 1840s on the rovinj film: bona defranceschi, daughter of dominicus defranceschi and oliva dorligurro , marrying antonius medelin . that is the third household above domenico's third marriage sending a daughter to rovinj. both of these places sat in this archive's inventory as unplaced . they are not unconnected; they are connected to each other, a hundred and twenty years apart, and nobody had put the two rows side by side.

t: LIBER COPULATORUM IN ECCLESIA S. BLASII ADIGNANI
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: liber copulatorum in ecclesia s. blasii adignani the marriage book is on dgs 005497894 , and familysearch has never indexed it . two hundred and eighty-six marriage-query arks were resolved against that film and not one of them landed on it. every marriage in this section has therefore been read off the page by eye, opening after opening. the volume's cover is at image 170 ; the first entry, annus 1815 , at image 172 ; the next volume begins at image 266 . roughly ninety-four openings, 1815 to 1884 . the folio numbers are stamped in the corner and run odd on the right 178 recto is folio 11, 179 recto folio 13 so the reading order can be checked against the book itself rather than against the film. what follows is images 172 182 : doc on every line, because every line was photographed and read.

t: 30 March 1818 the marriage this archive came for
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: 30 march 1818 the marriage this archive came for 15 30 marzo [1818] № domus 312 sponsus pietro de franceschi q.m gio. maria , vedovo della q.m veniera franzin q.m domenico cattolico d'anni 42 vedovo sponsa lorenza tesser q.m ambrogio , vedova del q.m andrea manzin fu altro andrea cattolica d'anni 40 vedova testes + gio. batta d'ambra, fabbro + antonio bellicaglia di giovanni, muratore a whole generation arrives in six lines. pietro is forty-two , so born about 1776 and his father gio. maria de franceschi is already dead , which carries the family in vodnjan back into the middle of the eighteenth century, well behind the register's own first page. he is a widower : there was a first wife, veniera franzin , daughter of a domenico franzin, and she died before march 1818. he marries another widow, lorenza tesser , whose first husband was andrea manzin. this is not the pietro of the baptism above. that one is pietro de franceschi di giuseppe di , father living. this one is q.m gio. maria father dead. two men of the same name in one small town at the same moment , and the register keeps them apart by naming the father every single time. (doc) one caution, marked plainly: the baptism register of 1816 records gio maria de franceschi as a living household head. if pietro's father gio. maria was dead by 1818, then the gio maria fathering children in the 1820s is a second man of the name

t: Two brothers, and both of them sign with a cross
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: two brothers, and both of them sign with a cross twice in 1818 a de franceschi stands as witness, and both times the clerk writes a cross before the name the mark of a man who cannot write his own. 30 march 1818 , entry 14, house 391, at the wedding of lorenzo bilucaglia and domenica giacometti: + cristoforo de franceschi di giuseppe tessitore a weaver . 14 september 1818 , entry 25, house 457, at the wedding of domenico coffetti and maria zoghil da gimino: + pietro de franceschi di giuseppe agricoltore the father of the child baptised in december 1816. cristoforo and pietro, both di giuseppe . same father, alive, named the same way in the same hand within six months: they are brothers . (inf, and a strong one) and a tension worth stating rather than smoothing over. the baptism of december 1816 records the household's conditio as civile . the marriage register calls pietro agricoltore and shows him unable to sign . those are the two columns of two different books and they may simply be asking different questions but this archive is not going to quietly publish the flattering one. (doc for both readings; the reconciliation is unresolved)

t: Don Stefano De Franceschi, placed and then given a father
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: don stefano de franceschi, placed and then given a father 15 7 giugno [1819] № domus 718 sponsus antonio, figlio di domenico belci q.m andrea e domenica giachin q.m domenico sponsa natalia, figlia del q.m stefano codalovich q.m ant.o e di vita tromba q.m cristoforo d'anni 20 testes don stefano de franceschi sacerdote martino fioranti fu giò. artista joannes tromba sac. theol. doct. parochus capitulique praepositus in the baptism of 4 december 1816 he appears as d. stefano de franceschi (de parocho licentia) he baptised the child by the parish priest's leave , which told us he was a priest but not which one, or whose. here he is again, thirty months later, signing as a witness in his own right and styled simply sacerdote . and the foot of the page names the man who gave him that leave: giovanni tromba, doctor of sacred theology, parish priest and provost of the chapter . so don stefano was not the parish priest of vodnjan. he was a priest of the town , one of the chapter's clergy, free to be asked for at a family baptism and to stand up at a neighbour's wedding. he is also, so far, the only literate de franceschi in vodnjan the only one whose name is written without a cross in front of it. (doc) and then, on 17 august 1820 , the clerk writes him out in full: d.n stefano de franceschi di giuseppe sacerdote di giuseppe. the same patronymic, in the same hand, in the same book, as +

t: Domenica De Franceschi, dead before the book begins
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: domenica de franceschi, dead before the book begins 21 19 novembre [1817] № domus 145 sponsus giuseppe, figlio di fran.co manzin q.m giuseppe e di cattarina manzin q.m andrea d'anni 25 sponsa giovanna, figlia di tommaso mivinurro q.m gio. e della fu dom.ca de franceschi d'anni 40 the bride is forty in 1817, so born about 1777 , and her mother domenica de franceschi was already dead when the entry was written. run it backwards. a woman whose daughter was born in 1777 was herself born somewhere around 1750 . she was baptised, married and buried in a vodnjan whose registers, on this film, do not start until 1815 . she is the reach of this book backwards past its own first page: proof of de franceschi in vodnjan by the middle of the eighteenth century , from a record written sixty years later. (doc for the entry; the arithmetic is inf) she also sits within a lifetime of ob.to di matt.o de franceschi da dignano , buried at rovinj on 27 december 1728 until today the only evidence this archive had that the name was in the town at all.

t: Nineteen times a witness, and the company he kept
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: nineteen times a witness, and the company he kept don stefano turns up again and again in the years the register has so far given up, and who he stands beside is the point . 7 june 1819 , house 718 with martino fioranti fu giò., artista 20 august 1819 , house 246 with the reverendissimo signor d. michiel benedetto, canonico coffetti 17 august 1820 , house 161 with d.r antonio de marchi q.m antonio, sacerdote , and here he is di giuseppe 13 november 1820 , house 588 with d. antonio de marchi again 3 july 1822 , house 200 with giacomo de marchi q.m antonio, agricoltore 28 october 1824 , house 208 with canon michiel benedetto again 16 february 1828 , house 464 with d. antonio de marchi , the two entered together as sacerdoti 23 september 1828 , house 73 with d. giacomo tosoni , sacerdote 25 november 1828 , house 344 with egidio de maria fu nicolò, possidente 25 november 1828 , house 329 the same day, the next couple , with giacomo de marchi, nunzolo he is never the officiant and never the parroco: giovanni tromba, doctor of sacred theology , signs the foot of every page as parochus capitulique praepositus . don stefano is a priest of the chapter , called on by families and standing at the altar rail beside canons. his brothers, in the same years, are being written into the same book with a cross in front of their names. q: a second sister, alive in 1819 19 30 giugno [1819] № domus 13 sponsus dom.co de rocchi, figlio del fu dom.co de rocchi fu veniere e di antonia forlani q.m ant.o, vedovo della fu vita manzin sponsa martina antonia , figlia del fu damiano storcovich e della vivente antonia maria de franceschi giugali cattolica d'anni 40 della vivente still living . where domenica de franceschi was la fu in 1817, antonia maria is alive in june 1819, widow of damiano storcovich, with a daughter of forty. so the register holds two de franceschi women of the generation born around 1750 , both married out of the name one dead, one alive whose daughters were born about 1777 and 1779 . they are almost certainly sisters, and they belong to a vodnjan household that no register on this film reaches. t: A third woman of the name, and a wedding full of nobles
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: a third woman of the name, and a wedding full of nobles 20 14 novembre [1821] № domus 54 sponsus lorenzo , figlio di dom.co michiele mainuzzo q.m andrea e di bonetta forlani di lorenzo, giugali d'anni 21 sponsa maria , figlia di alvise birattan q.m saba e di lucia de franceschi q.m pietro , giugali d'anni 21 testes sig. giannandrea dalla zonca q.m benedetto, nobile sig. guglielmo conte lombardo di felice, da pola, nobile dispensa dal quarto grado di consanguinità, sub № 23 lucia de franceschi q.m pietro a third woman of the name married out of it, after domenica and antonia maria. her daughter is twenty-one, so born about 1800 ; lucia herself married by 1799 and her father pietro was dead by 1821. he cannot be the pietro who remarried in 1818, who was only forty-two so this is an older pietro again , and another branch the baptism register never reaches. and look who signs. not a ploughman and a weaver but giannandrea dalla zonca , of the family that gave vodnjan its best-known nineteenth-century writer, and count guglielmo lombardo of pola two nobles standing up at the wedding of a granddaughter of a de franceschi. the couple also needed a dispensation in the fourth degree of consanguinity , which is the register quietly telling us these families had married each other before. t: da Dignano the name written down from outside the town
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: da dignano the name written down from outside the town 4 30 gennaro [1824] № domus 409 testes matteo tromba q.m gio. da sissano , agricoltore pietro de franceschi di gio., da dignano tessitore d.n giannantonio bozorich, cooperatore di sissano, li sposò in sissano the couple were married not at st blaise but at šišan (sissano) , ten kilometres south, by that village's own curate and because the clerk is writing about strangers he says where each man is from . so the witness is set down as pietro de franceschi di gio. , da dignano, tessitore . two things come out of that line. a man this archive did not have. not pietro di giuseppe the ploughman, not pietro q.m gio. maria who remarried in 1818 aged forty-two a pietro son of a giovanni, and a weaver . the clerk writes di giuseppe in full elsewhere in the same book, so the abbreviation is his own and it means giovanni. (doc; that he is a fourth distinct pietro is inf, and the possibility of a slip is left standing) and it is the same formula as 1728. ob.to di matt.o de franceschi da dignano , in the rovinj book of burial offerings. a man of this family is called of vodnjan only when he is written about somewhere else. ninety-six years apart, in two different parishes' books, the same phrase does the same work.

t: A second line, and it goes back to a Domenico

(doc for both entries; the brother-and-sister reading is inf) so the line stands: domenico de franceschi dead before his son was written down this way pietro q.m domenico × domenica manzin dead by 1823 bonetta , born about 1800, married 1823 pietro q.m pietro , ploughman, 1824 that is a domenico at the head of it , and domenico is the given name that runs through three of the eight households the baptism register produced. whether this pietro is also the q.m pietro who fathered lucia married out by 1799 the register has not yet said, and this archive will not

t: A third daughter and a name this archive got wrong
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: a third daughter and a name this archive got wrong 1 15 gennaro 1825 № domus 667 sponsus gio. maria , figlio delli fu giugali andrea fioranti q.m antonio e veniera bonassin fu gio. ma. q.m francesco d'anni 32 sponsa lucia , figlia di alvise birattan q.m saba e di lucia de franceschi q.m pietro d'anni 28 testes d.r giacomo tosoni, sacerdote giacomo de marchi q.m ant.o a third daughter of the same couple , and with her the household is complete on the page: lucia , 28 in january 1825 born about 1797 maria , 21 in november 1821 born about 1800 bianca , 20 in june 1824 born about 1804 so lucia de franceschi q.m pietro was married by about 1796 , and her father pietro was dead well before 1821. three weddings out of one house, and not one of these women appears in any index anywhere. and a correction, in the place where the mistake was made. earlier today this page called the husband alvise bortolan q.m saba . that was a misreading of the hand. this third entry writes it clearly, and the two earlier ones say the same thing when you go back and look: the name is alvise birattan q.m saba . bortolan was this archive's word, not the register's, and it has been changed above.

t: Pietro had a brother, and the first line widens
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: pietro had a brother, and the first line widens 6 25 gennaro 1826 № domus 224 sponsa michiela , figlia di cristoforo de franceschi q.m gio: maria e di maria luigia manzin q.m domenico , giugali cattolica d'anni 26 celibe testes giacomo de marchi fu ant.o manzin manzin fu dom.co, agricoltori q.m gio: maria the same dead father as the pietro who remarried in march 1818 at forty-two. so cristoforo is pietro's brother , and the eldest line in vodnjan now has two sons in it instead of one: gio. maria de franceschi , dead before 1818 pietro , born about 1776 → his son gio: maria , married 1821 cristoforo × maria luigia manzin q.m domenico → his daughter michiela , born about 1800, married 1826 and here is the trap this parish sets. there are now two men called cristoforo de franceschi alive in vodnjan at the same time : this one, q.m gio: maria , and the weaver , di giuseppe , who signed with a cross in 1818. they are not the same man and they are not in the same family. the register keeps them apart by the father's name and by nothing else which is exactly why these pages have to be read rather than searched. t: Antonio, son of Vittorio, at a wedding in Svetvinčenat
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: antonio, son of vittorio, at a wedding in svetvinčenat 29 10 luglio 1826 № domus 18 testes ant.o de franceschi fu vittorio martino suspich q.m martino agricoltori d.n alessandro fonsa, arciprete, li congiunse in sanvicenti another wedding held outside the parish this time at savičenta, which is svetvinčenat and again the outside venue makes the clerk name people properly. antonio de franceschi fu vittorio . vittorio is not a vodnjan name in anything read so far. it is a rovinj name: the household this archive pulled off the rovinj film runs giacomo → vittorio, with domenica moscarda → piero anto, 1736 . and svetvinčenat is the parish where this archive has been reading a quite separate cluster mattia 1669, mattio 1674, piero 1707, and the nineteen openings of baptisms finished earlier this week. so one line of a vodnjan marriage register touches both of the other southern istrian places at once: a man carrying a rovinj given-name in his patronymic, standing up at a wedding in svetvinčenat. this archive is not going to claim the three clusters are one family on that. it is recording that the register put them in the same room. (doc for the entry; any connection is open, and unproved)

t: 26 January 1833 and this archive was wrong about him
s: Vodnjan: a question, a wrong answer, and then the register
q: 26 january 1833 and this archive was wrong about him 1 26 gennajo 1833 № domus 177 subscriptio sacerdotis copulantis: d.n stefano de franceschi, de parochi lic., li congiunse e benedisse nella chiesa parrocchiale he married them himself. joined them and blessed them in the parish church. this archive has said, on this page and in its commit messages, that don stefano appears nineteen times as a witness and never once as the officiant . that was true of every entry from 1819 to the end of 1832. it stops being true on 26 january 1833 , and it is corrected here rather than quietly amended. what does not change is how he acts: de parochi lic. by the parish priest's licence . it is the same formula as the baptism of december 1816, de parocho licentia . don stefano is never the parson of vodnjan; he is a priest of the chapter who steps in when giovanni tromba licenses him to , at a family baptism in 1816 and at the altar in 1833. seventeen years apart, the register uses the same three words about him. t: What it is and is not
s: And there is a palace in Zadar with the name on it
q: what it is and is not a double-barrelled house name in zadar means a marriage, not a merger: a franceschi daughter or son married into the grisogono, and the palace carried both names afterwards. the grisogono are one of the oldest patrician families of the city heyer von rosenfeld starts their genealogy at a grisogono de grisogoni in 1290. this archive does not know which franceschi. it knows that in zadar the name was attached to two buildings on the main street, and that is more than it knew this morning.

t: Brooklyn, 1 April 1930 three of the Eleven under one roof
q: brooklyn, 1 april 1930 three of the eleven under one roof united states census of 1930, brooklyn, kings county, new york nara t626, roll 1495. read the four names against the reunion chart. albina is the sixth of the eleven, born at gračišće on 14 april 1900. anthony is the eldest, born 18 february 1887 and the census gives his year of immigration as 1922 , which is the year of the passenger list this archive found under his name. and grochina is what a brooklyn enumerator made of gioacchino , the tenth child, born 12 august 1907, whom the family called bruno . a sister, her husband, and two of her brothers, in one flat, on one census night. one of them had crossed the atlantic eight years earlier; one would marry a german girl from hanover sixteen months later. nothing in this archive had put any two of them in the same room.

t: Gallignana returns ten records in the whole of Findmypast and three are ours
q: gallignana returns ten records in the whole of findmypast and three are ours the obvious search, and nobody had run it. type the village's italian name into the keyword box of a database of billions of records and ten results come back . three carry this family's name. joseph defranceschi petition for naturalization, brooklyn, 1915. birth date 12 mar 1892 birth country austria birth place as transcribed: gallignana, austria . petition 13838, declaration 22660, certificate 1104860 . albina schinkepan petition for naturalization, brooklyn, 1928. birth date 14 apr 1900 birth place as transcribed: gallignana, austria husband frank schinkepan, born 24 feb 1896 . petition 100185. the name of this village is written into the federal records of the united states, twice, by two of the eleven children of antonio and maria. not austria , not italy , not trieste gallignana . it is the plainest documentary tie between the hill town this archive is built on and the country half the family went to. the other seven are the village's other emigrants, and they are worth naming because a village of that size sends its people out together: poldrugovac thomas (b.1899, petitions of 1921 and 1941) and poldrugovaz santo (b.1900, 1946); millassich leopoldo (b.1883) and emilia (b.1889), arriving 1912; lanza anthony (b.1892); silich victor. six surnames out of one parish, in the new york courts.

t: 11 … 1922 the Conte Rosso, Genoa to New York
q: 11 … 1922 the conte rosso, genoa to new york and then the two records that sit beside each other in the index, one number apart, on one page of one ship's manifest. antonio de franceschi passenger male age 35y birth year 1887 nationality italy, slovenian residence g. pedena, venezia, italy year 1922 departure port genoa arrival new york ship name conte rosso. and in the relations field: departure port relation (wife): marta defranceschi . albina de franceschi passenger female age 22y birth year 1900 nationality italy, italian residence g. gallignana, venezia year 1922 departure port genoa arrival new york ship name conte rosso. brother and sister, thirty-five and twenty-two, on the same crossing. the eldest of the eleven and the sixth, going down to genoa from opposite ends of the same few miles of istria he from pedena, which is pićan , the cathedral town over the hill; she from gallignana . the conte rosso was a lloyd sabaudo liner two years old that year. three details this archive did not have and would not have guessed. antonio was living at pićan, not gračišće. he left a wife behind him marta defranceschi, named at the departure port, which is why the census of 1930 finds him married but lodging with his sister eight years later. and an american clerk wrote his nationality as italy, slovenian and hers as italy, italian the same household, the same village, sorted into two

frank, out of pisino albina's husband takes a different spelling in every record chinikopan on the 1925 marriage licence, chinkojan in the 1930 census, schinkepan on her 1928 petition. search the keyword pisino and he appears under a fourth: schinkopan, frank, born 1896 united states naturalization petitions, new york, 1920 and 1926. born 24 february 1896 , out of pisino pazin , the county town. he declared his intention in 1920, petitioned in 1926, married albina of gallignana in between, and by 1930 was keeping a brooklyn household with two of her brothers in it. four spellings of one man, and the archive can now say where he came from.

t: 23 April 1925 Albina's marriage, and her mother's name
q: 23 april 1925 albina's marriage, and her mother's name albine defranceschi , spinster, aged 25, born 1900 married frank chinikopan , aged 28, born 1897, at kings county, new york, on 23 april 1925 . father's first name(s): anton. mother's first name(s): maria. mother's last name: volhart. that is the couple at the head of the 2012 chart antonio defranceschi 1856 1924 + maria valhart 1867 1945 and it is the surname the gračišće status animarum of 1925 spells volhardt . a new york clerk, working from what the bride told him, wrote her mother's maiden name into the civil record of the state of new york. the reunion album's albina chinkopan is frank chinikopan , and this archive now has the day.

t: 30 July 1931 Bruno's marriage, and the name the gravestone cut off
q: 30 july 1931 bruno's marriage, and the name the gravestone cut off bruno de franceschi , single, aged 24, birth place: istria, italy married gerda seedorf , aged 18, birth place: hanover, germany , at manhattan on 30 july 1931 . his father anton ; his mother mary walhal . her father john seedorf; her mother anna huntsen. the stone at nine partners cemetery, millbrook, gave this archive a wife it could read only as gerda se… . she was gerda seedorf of hanover , eighteen years old, marrying a boy from istria in manhattan two years into the depression.

q: 1939 a declaration of intention at brooklyn, and whose it really is united states naturalization petitions, brooklyn, kings, new york, 1939. declaration of intention no. 284221 ; certificate 2-665402 . first name bruno last name de franceschi birth date 12 aug 1907 spouse gerda de franceschi, born 15 jan 1913 relation 2: child, born 2 december 1932 . 12 august 1907 is the reunion album's date for gioacchino, to the day. but see the correction below : the image behind this index entry is gerda's own declaration, not bruno's, and everything here was extracted from her form. there is a son, born 2 december 1932, who is not named here because he may be living.

t: Uncle Joe, from a draft card to a war grave

basilio, to the day the youngest of the eleven, basilio, born 29 september 1909 . the social security death index and the obituary index agree: basilio defranceschi 29 september 1909 15 june 1994 new york, new york , social security number issued in new york. born at gračišće while it was austria; died in new york city, aged eighty-four, in the summer of 1994. this archive had no death date for him at all.

t: The mother's name, in three hands
q: the mother's name, in three hands it is worth setting these side by side, because they were written by three different clerks, in three different years, from what three different children of the same woman told them: albina, 1925 anton maria volhart joseph, 1926 anton maria valbart bruno, 1931 anton mary walhal and the parish book of souls at gračišće, house 24: maria volhardt , 6 april 1867 3 october 1945. four spellings, one woman. this is what a german surname does in the mouths of istrian children and the ears of new york registrars, and it is the strongest identification in this whole sweep: the three of the eleven who married in new york all named the same mother.
